content.text: What Time Does The Boys Season 5 Release on Prime Video?The fifth and final season of The Boys will officially premiere on April 8, 2026, exclusively on Prime Video. It will debut at midnight for most U.S. viewers who’ll finally be able to watch the last chapter of this Emmy-winning superhero drama.
